faqs.a: Full Management is 20% of revenue, Digital is 12%. No hidden fees, no setup costs. You only pay when you earn.
Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time with no penalties. We'll handle the transition seamlessly.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get started?
faqs.a: If your property is guest-ready, we can be live within 5–7 business days. We handle photography, listing creation, platform setup, and pricing calibration — you just hand us the keys.

faqs.q: How is short-term rental income taxed?
faqs.a: Short-term rental income is taxed in tiers: 15% up to €12K, 25% from €12K–24K, 35% from €24K–35K, and 45% for €35K+. You declare the total booking amount to AADE, including the platform commission.

Yes, according to the new law, civil liability insurance for the property is now mandatory by the Greek state for short-term rentals. While platforms like Airbnb offer some coverage (AirCover), a dedicated short-term rental insurance policy ensures full legal compliance and provides the most comprehensive protection.

faqs.q: Can I still use my property?
faqs.a: Of course! Block off any dates through the owner portal — just make sure there's no existing booking for those dates. Your property, your schedule. We'll optimize pricing around your availability.

faqs.q: How does the co-hosting model work?
faqs.a: Homevision is added as a co-host on booking platforms. You remain the owner with full access. We handle the day-to-day operations while you maintain complete visibility through the owner portal.

faqs.q: Does my property need to be new?
faqs.a: Not at all — it just needs to be clean and well-maintained. A property with character can stand out beautifully. In today's competitive market, the rule is: the more amenities and quality touches you offer, the better your results.

faqs.q: How fast do you respond to guests?
faqs.a: Within 30 minutes, 24/7. From pre-booking inquiries through post-checkout follow-ups. We maintain communication from before guests book until after they leave.
For city-center apartments, guests typically prefer self-check-in with lockbox or smart lock. For villas, personal welcome is recommended. We adapt to your preferences and property type.

faqs.q: How and when do I get paid?
faqs.a: Funds are deposited to your bank account 1–2 business days after the platform sends the payout. After each booking, you receive a detailed revenue report via email plus 24/7 access through the owner portal.
Every booking is covered by platform damage protection. We document property condition before and after each stay and manage all claims on your behalf.
